sourcePdf.methodText:
To cook artichokes, cut off stem and 1 inch from top, trim tips off large leaves, if desired.

Stand upright in deep saucepan to hold snugly.

Add 2 to 3 inches of boiling water, 1/3 tsp. salt for each artichoke, and 1 Tbsp. lemon juice.

Cover and gently boil 30 to 45 minutes, or until base can be easily pierced with a fork.

Drain. Gently spread leaves; remove choke or thistle portion with metal spoon.

Turn upside down, drain, chill.

Combine oil, vinegar, salt, spices, herbs, garlic, and 1/4 cup water in saucepan.

Heat to boiling; boil gently 5 minutes.

Add carrots, flowerets, and mushrooms. Heat to boiling; boil gently 3 to 5 minutes or until crisp tender.

Chill in liquid. Drain, reserving marinade.

In large bowl combine vegetables, salami, cheese, pimiento and tuna; toss gently to keep tuna whole.

Spoon mixture into each artichoke.

Serve with reserved marinade for dipping leaves. Stir marinade frequently.
